scope: Representative actual hotel buffet2F, gym4F, spa5F and office cafeteria. Production physical E edges start/stop every happy-path action; floor navigation uses physical E picker plus production request_floor. Recorded scenario starts position only before controller walks; no handle_interact call or counter injection. Independent actual MeshInstance3D role/transform observations, real stats and physics lock, pause exactness, solid LOS rejection, reset cleanup and source collision inventory. Native normal-camera PNGs and HUD bounds only when display is not headless. Authored game facilities; no real hotel service, nutrition/health claim, full catalog action audit, human OS keyboard input, performance or fluid simulation acceptance.
